title: Transactional Commit Engine & Canonical Service Delegation

architecture.lifecycleTransition: APPROVED -> COMMITTING -> COMMITTED (or FAILED on error)

preCommitVerification.approvalCurrency: Enforced via CanonicalReviewApprovalService five-point binding check
preCommitVerification.authorization: Enforced via CanonicalSecurityService COMMIT operation check
preCommitVerification.projectIsolation: Enforced across session, artifact, and approval

architecture.auditTrail: Enforced via CanonicalAuditService append-only audit events
architecture.directFirestoreWrites: Zero direct writes; canonical domain service delegation only
